model.name: Identifiers are measured-random v4 by construction — no invented/parent-prefixed uuids, no manufactured prefix-collisions
model.description: Every unit uuid and marker is a MEASURED-random v4 (from uuidgen), never an identifier INVENTED with structure. Kills the defect GENERATOR, not just its output: the retired -a1b2/-b1c2/-c1d2 convention minted an Impl uuid as <Method-8char-prefix>+mnemonic-suffix so it would 'look related' to its Method — which MANUFACTURED 8 genuine 8-char prefix-collisions. resolvePrefix then silently picked the FIRST match on the Test-MOVE path = a Test credited to the WRONG owner and a QA-Review number that lies. Fix by-construction on BOTH sides: the generator (independent v4, no parent-prefix) AND the resolver (fail-closed on ambiguous prefix, never first-match), plus a retroactive sweep. The retro-audit came back CLEAN only because every ref was written as a FULL uuid — the full-uuid rule was LOAD-BEARING, not cosmetic.

discoverySource.note: Surfaced by the dangling-ref/fabrication campaign (prefix-collision + bad-variant + non-v4 families). Consistency-by-construction sibling to R37.13 (naming-canon) — identifiers can't be fabricated by construction. Chain to be confirmed by architect.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every NEW unit (any ior:class:*) gets an INDEPENDENT random v4 uuid (uuidgen/uuid4) — NEVER a parent-prefix + mnemonic suffix (no <Method-8char>+a1b2/b1c2/c1d2), never hand-typed / sequential / structured. Minting reads the uuid from uuidgen, never constructs it.

A fabricated-identifier guard forbids: a child uuid SHARING its parent's 8-char prefix (manufactured-collision detector), a non-v4 uuid (bad version/variant nibble), a malformed/non-hex id, an all-zero tail, and set-wise inter-id nibble-delta regularity (co-minted-set fabrication). It matches RESOLVED markers + on-disk unit uuids, NOT generator source/templates. STUB-MUST-FAIL: a planted parent-prefixed child or non-v4 id -> RED; weaken/remove the guard -> suite RED (else it certifies nothing).

resolvePrefix is FAIL-CLOSED on an ambiguous 8-char prefix (>1 match -> REFUSE with a named reason), NEVER silent first-match — closing the Test-MOVE wrong-owner-credit path (per resolveprefix-fail-closed-guard.md). Generator (no manufactured collisions) + resolver (no first-match) together, not either alone.

RETRO: the existing -a1b2 Impls + the 35 non-v4 S18 Requirement uuids are re-minted to independent v4; a uuid change = REF-REWRITE (R27.2 remap shape: labelled snapshot -> dry-run + count -> rewrite every referrer -> verify -> conservation-invariant unit-count unchanged before==after). MARKERS-FIRST (2 malformed markers ViewBus e5145c01 / server.ts:1942 dnd01001 before non-v4 unit-uuids, per architect priority — malformed markers are silently-broken chains).

FULL uuids in EVERY ref, READ + WRITE (no 8-char prefixes in markers/refs/ops). Codified as an AC because the retro-audit came back CLEAN ONLY because every ref was a full uuid — the rule is load-bearing (a prefix ref would have resolved to the wrong manufactured-collision twin).

SCOPE (named, no-silent-caps) from the read-only scan: 2 malformed MARKERS + 35 non-v4 S18 Requirement uuids (sequential, self-consistent) + the -a1b2 Impl cluster. EXCLUDE ~10 marker-tooling regex/template false-positives + the short markerPending markers (flip on their C4 mint) — the excluded set is LISTED, never silently dropped; dropping an item from the exclude-list surfaces it back into the guard.

TEST/BITE (distinct-intent): plant a child uuid sharing its parent's 8-char prefix -> guard RED; plant a non-v4 / malformed / all-zero-tail id -> RED; resolvePrefix on an ambiguous 8-char -> REFUSE (fail-closed) not first-match; weaken any guard -> suite RED. Verify Impl.tests[] on disk before flip.
